verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents its own Cloud Billing REST API for managing billing programmatically. It also offers a Budget API that tracks actual spend against planned spend and can push notifications to Pub/Sub. Together these give some programmatic access to cost signals beyond the console. However, nothing in the evidence shows a query interface over detailed cost line items, scheduled cost exports, or resource-level granularity. Missing for 10: scheduled cost/billing exports (e.g., to a queryable data store), resource-level cost granularity, a documented cost-query API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
